identity.mission: Create a sober, professional accounting tool that feels like a high-end financial instrument, not a generic SaaS.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the main dashboard.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL numerical data, account numbers, and financial totals.
Ensure high contrast for all text (WCAG AA compliant).
Use the provided image URLs for the login page and empty states.
Customize Shadcn components to have 'rounded-sm' (2px-4px) instead of default rounded-md/lg to fit the 'Swiss Professional' look.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds; use solid colors or subtle noise textures if needed.
Ensure the PDF viewer and justification table are the focal points of the application.
universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects for sticky headers.
Never use transparent backgrounds without a blur or scrim.
